description: Signal health per stress run (docs/specs/signal-health.md; src/scenariogen/signal_health.py). max_staleness_days is the largest gap, in days, between the run's as_of and the newest date a source's data carries before the source counts as stale (degraded). null marks a source that is not dated (MacroRAG, XbrlRag and throughput report coverage and holds only). Stricter than the news gate (200 days): health flags a stale feed long before the gate holds it.
